# 1. Loading packages

```{r}
#| label: loading-packages
#| warning: false

# loading neccessary packages
library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)
library(here)
library(corrplot)
library(showtext)
```

# 2. Adding custom fonts and loading ggplot2

```{r}
#| label: loading-font-adding-ggplot2

# choosing font from google library
font_add_google("EB Garamond", "garamond")
# ensures text will be automatically rendered on new devices
showtext_auto()

library(ggplot2)
```
